selectionPolicy.auto: Exact requested weather variant only; unknown, disabled, unavailable or missing weather uses day/night closed-curtain time-only according to the effective isDay.
selectionPolicy.manual: Only the user-selected palette chooses its admitted empty-room appearance; this is not a real-weather assertion.
selectionPolicy.camera: Original 1536x1024 canvas, common full-height uniform scale and right anchor; preview uses the same 3:2 canvas.
selectionPolicy.characterBoundary: ambient-only does not count as a completed character/activity layer.
